reference_wholesale_price_description: Ofgem Annex 2 direct-fuel electricity index before supplier uplifts and losses. It is retained solely as the reference point for the modelled wholesale-price delta.

source.levelised_workbook: Annex 9 - Levelisation allowance methodology and levelised cap levels v1.10, July to September 2026
source.prelevelised_workbook: Energy price cap levels: pre-levelised rates model v1.30, July to September 2026

limitations: Rates are published maximum charges, not a supplier's actual tariff.
The counterfactual mode changes only the direct electricity commodity price using a PyPSA demand-weighted wholesale-price delta. It is not a statutory price-cap calculation.
Network, policy, operating, capacity-market, CfD, backwardation, EBIT, headroom and levelisation allowances remain embedded in this published snapshot.
